steps.name: A Fragrance for You (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Shynic] in 「Underground City Tartaros」, then find [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...I thought everything would be fun once we'd dealt with Weiss...
(Shynic lies sprawled on the ground, writing 'I'm bored.' Used to this sight, Melvic pokes her shoulder with a small stick.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic, would you like to run a lap around Tartaros?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't want to run.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then is there anything you've wanted to do? Something out of the ordinary?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Who knows? Something I want to do... I've never really made plans for my life...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You said you had plenty to do from now on.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Those are things I have to do, not things I want to do... And not right away. Io and old Ziskad said they'd discuss it first.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I don't like it, but the Kingdom of Jude is involved too. I suppose nothing can happen until that's settled?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: An entertaining face spotted. ♡

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's been a while, %s. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well too, Melvic?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Nothing much happened while Lady Shynic was away, apart from catching a few devils trying to enter Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Devils...?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: When Lady Shynic is absent, quite a few devils and demons are drawn to the power seeping from the Abyss Chamber. So I put them inside it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's my butler.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You really are no ordinary butler.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, right. Melvic, I've thought of a plan.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Splendid, Lady Shynic! May I ask what it is?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I need something, so I'm taking %s to look for it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? What is it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll explain on the way. It's something I need to pay my respects, and I need you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pay your respects...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go together. Where are we headed?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Good question. Where shall we go? Let's talk to Frozen first. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, yes. Let's get moving.

steps.name: A Fragrance for You (2)
steps.objective:
In 「Purgatory Azrael」, defeat [Tamiel] to obtain <Perse's Baby's Breath>, and defeat [Sinner Vice] to obtain <Proof of Bondage>.
Then turn in the quest to [Frozen] in 「Avalon」.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Luu started acting differently. I wondered who it was. So it's you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it did.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Oh, who's behind you...? So...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What were you about to say, Frozen? Something like 'too small to see,' perhaps? Or 'too small to see'?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: How could I say such a thing about someone with a presence greater than anyone else's?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh?
(Impressed by Frozen's response, Shynic turns to look at %s.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You should learn from him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose I should.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Ahaha... Working under the pope has taught me a few things. Ah, please forget I said that. What brings you here, Lady Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm looking for something. ♡

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Something for Lady Medea, as before?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What? You knew?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Quite by chance, my powers of perception improved a little. Perhaps I should thank Belosh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belosh?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I can't say the divine power that escaped him had no effect. And Luu has grown heavier. My shoulder is suffering.
(Listening to Frozen, Luu produces eyebrows it did not have before and furrows them.)

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Whatever else you may say, Luu, admit you've put on weight. Hahaha. Anyway, what are you looking for, Lady Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When I returned from the realm of the dead, I brought a flower with me. I need it. With that, I think I can pay my respects properly.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: A flower? I believe I saw one in Purgatory that seemed out of place in Avalon...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Did the Angel of Chaos have it...? I'd better go and look.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen, those doors are still here. Can we go back inside?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Of course. What do you think of Avalon's condition now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From what I felt on the way here... Hmm... I can't feel anything at all.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The doors remain, and we can still enter. Vanitas and Purgatory look just as they did before. I was certain they were disappearing then.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Hard to believe, but true. I don't know which world those spaces Weiss spoke of belong to...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: So I've been looking for something to report to the order, but I haven't found anything suitable.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So you want %s to look while we're there. Apparently you're rather good at finding things?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: I heard about something you found on the other side before. Perhaps wherever you set foot, %s, new places and paths open.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: New places and paths...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: ...I don't know what path it will be, but I hope it leads somewhere good. Don't lose yourself at fate's crossroads...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Walk toward what you believe in. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Beings like Weiss are still in this world. Others may come, too.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Will you be all right, Lady Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I don't die easily. ♡ I hope we can find everything in one trip.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: So do I. Because of those letters I sealed away before, this poor soul had to visit the same place over and over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Lady Shynic, bring the flower to me and I will bless it in a different form.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All right. The touch of death might make it wither. Will you stay here?

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Yes. I'm looking nearby for evidence to submit to the order. I'll wait here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'd better finish quickly. I don't want to linger in Avalon. It's such a bother...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll be back.

steps.name: A Fragrance for You (3)
steps.objective:
1. Clear 「Dreaming Oneiro」 and talk to [Shynic].
2. Defeat [Belosh] in 「Vanitas」 and obtain <Burning Timber>.
3. Talk to [Shynic] in 「Underground City Tartaros」 and complete the quest.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Welcome back, Lady Shynic. From your cheerful step, I take it you found what you wanted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen, here's the item.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Lady Shynic made a very good choice bringing you along.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: This flower is rare and special, so make it even more special. ♡ Be careful with it.
(Holding the baby's breath, Frozen closes his eyes in prayer. The spirit Luu draws a tiny light from somewhere and guides it into the flower.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Live long enough, and even a demigod gives you a blessing. Really...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's amazing.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Here you are, Lady Shynic.
(As Shynic accepts the baby's breath, its tiny petals drift free and turn into little lights, gathering around her as she watches in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I wasn't sure it would work, but Frozen managed it. Light that transforms when the heart holds longing.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: The scriptures say this light is born of feelings for someone missed beyond death.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Send it toward the one you long for, Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I will. Thank you, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: You're welcome, Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Guide me through Oneiro Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: See you later, Frozen. Oh, visit only for good reasons. A demigod turning up usually means trouble, so make sure you only come with good news!

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: Haha. I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll be going, Frozen.

lines.speaker: 프로즌
lines.text: All right. Take care.
(After wandering for a long time through the forest, now entirely without dreamers, Shynic and %s finally stop.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So this is the place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. This is where I met the forest guardian and Eda.
(Shynic quietly surveys her surroundings, then notices a flower bed full of green and yellow leaves.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: These flowers...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No one's been tending them. Of course they've wilted.
(Shynic crouches and reaches out to touch the petals. The lights hovering close to her gently descend onto the flower bed.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eda, I'm sorry. I should have come as soon as I heard about you. But only now...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm so late, aren't I? Don't worry. I've kept your ribbon safe.
(For a long time, Shynic strokes the petals, unable to continue.)

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: 「Don't be sorry. You did nothing wrong, Shynic.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What was that? Am I imagining it? Where did that voice come from?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I suppose I forgot for so long. We could have met sooner... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I have good friends now. I won't be lonely until we meet again. And...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When we do meet again... just like long ago... be my friend, so I won't be bored.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sleep peacefully, then...
(Shynic rises with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm glad I brought the baby's breath back when I returned from death. It let me share my feelings like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Lady Shynic?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If I'm not, will you die for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, but if you're saying things like that, I suppose you're all right.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe. Let's go. Oh! I forgot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When we went into the empty Purgatory earlier, I forgot we needed to visit Vanitas too. Sorry.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I need to repair the Burning Wheel. Find wood there with a similar feel to the wheel, set it alight, cut it into suitable pieces, and put it in this.
(Shynic hands %s a sack made of an unfamiliar material.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If the wheel isn't repaired, our rookie goddess will be overwhelmed with work. Can you go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's what it's for, I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You always react immediately when it's about our rookie goddess.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just bring one good piece of wood. One is enough.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll stay here a little longer, then return to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Lady Shynic.
(After %s leaves, Shynic quietly looks at the withered flower bed.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'd like to take these flowers and plant them in Tartaros. Would it work? Could they grow properly there?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Should I ask Medea? Oh, I don't know. Coming back would be a bother...
(Shynic gazes absently at the sky and mutters.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Rookie goddess. ♡ Can I call in a favor? You said one of your friends was a flower spirit, right?
(No sooner has Shynic spoken than something falls onto the flower bed. A moment later, a girl covered in petals rises angrily among the flowers.)
Iris, ye can't just send me off without warning! Ye hear me?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That floral scent... She sent a flower spirit. You are a spirit, right?
Did ye call me? I'm no spirit who comes running just because someone calls.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: An ancient spirit, judging by that accent. I can trust you with this favor. ♡ I'm Shynic, of Tartaros...

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: I'm Zoe. I know who ye are. What d'ye need help with?
(The usually quiet Tartaros is noisy. Clouds of dust rise here and there, as though construction has begun.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough, cough. Is something happening in Tartaros?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I just felt like doing something for once. Did you bring what I asked for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, here. I found suitable wood, set it on fire, and cut it up, just as you said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But this sack... It looks like the one I put Curiring in before...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I saw that one and made a rough copy. ♡ Handy, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, very. But the wood I burned... It's still on fire, yet strangely it doesn't feel hot.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's because it's from another world. Even actions in that space seem to work differently from our world.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The Burning Wheel, Vanitas... If Weiss had never come to our world, we'd never have had to go there.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, who knows? I hate complicated things. ♡ It's already happened. What can we do?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So... I'll repair the wheel with this. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look happy, Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Of course. I have something to do... %s, I'm having fun. Thanks to you, I don't think I'll be bored nearly as often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's good to hear.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe. I'm glad you came to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll keep visiting to help.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You have your own work to do. I'll find things I need to do here. So come to visit, not to help. All right?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now I sound like Io. Melvic, put that here.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, Lady Shynic. Oh, you're back, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back. What's that, Melvic?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic returned with a great many flower seedlings she intends to plant.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: ...I don't know how many there are, but more than enough to fill Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These flowers...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Those are the flowers from Oneiro Forest... They were wilted. How did she revive them?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I called in our rookie goddess' friend, didn't I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you mean Zoe?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That ancient spirit with the funny accent helped me and went home. Those flowers are my task now.
(Shynic smiles brightly at a flower blooming in the soil.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Melvic, we're going to fill this whole place with flowers. My power will make them bloom. ♡ I want to give life now, instead of taking it.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Wonderful, Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, right. %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Help me plant the flowers!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Didn't you just tell me to come and visit rather than help?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's from next time! Help me today!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much planting are we talking about?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: From one end of Tartaros to the other?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's been so long since Lady Shynic was this enthusiastic... I never thought I'd live to see the day.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Cheeky words from someone so young.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic, I am the oldest in this town after you. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: When was it that I found this boy, healed him, and brought him here...? Melvic, this could be a long story. Let's take a break.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Of course. I expected as much, so I prepared refreshments.
(Melvic opens his picnic basket and sets out drinks and light refreshments for Shynic and %s.)
(After taking a satisfied sip, Shynic begins the story of how she met Melvic long ago.)
(How she and Medea found him dying in a village, and went to Divine Tree Lapier to save him.)
(As though that were not enough, Shynic continues sharing old stories she has never told anyone, not even Melvic.)
(There was once a girl who found nothing interesting. Through new meetings and farewells, in what may have been only a brief span of her life, that girl had certainly changed.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Story over. ♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now, let's enjoy ourselves! This is going to be fun!
